name: Dimir Keyrune — "…artifact creature until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn" still becomes the creature
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). The trailing "and can't be blocked this turn" hit the becomes-parser's skip words, so the whole ability produced nothing. The evasion clause is cut off first. The Keyrune is a 2/2 blue and black Horror artifact creature.
